The eval interpreter matches paths with its own walker instead of calling libc, so nothing about
the compiled path's correctness carries over. Before this it answered a runtime fatal to every
flagged call while php answered a listing — and the compiled side declaring the parameter would
only have widened that gap.

The brace expectations are the ones that were measured rather than assumed: the sort runs PER
EXPANSION (`{c*,a*}` answers c before a), duplicates survive, and an unmatched `{` matches not
